title: UK Generations Study R0 questionnaire (schemify pilot) — shared definitions
description: Only invariant tokens are centralised here; context-specific sentinels are inlined per field because their meanings differ by variable.

missing_numeric.title: Missing or not recorded
missing_numeric.description: The source data has no distinguishing code for why a numeric or coded value is absent — agent-decided sentinel, since BaselineMetadata.xlsx's Answers sheet defines no dedicated missing-value code for these fields. Open for steward confirmation at review.

missing_string.title: Missing or not recorded
missing_string.description: The source data has no distinguishing code for why a string value is absent — agent-decided sentinel, mirroring missing_numeric for string-typed fields. Open for steward confirmation at review.

dont_know.title: Don't know
dont_know.description: The participant indicated they did not know the answer. Harmonised from BaselineMetadata.xlsx's Answers sheet, AnswerID=3 — reused verbatim across 49 answer rows in the source. D011 (2026-09-18) fixes -888 as the one universal recoded value for this meaning everywhere it appears, replacing the source's per-question local code; confirmed final by the steward. A field whose own local code for this meaning must be preserved (e.g. a companion flag-field's own coding, D004) inlines its own const + title instead of $ref'ing this def — see D017.

dont_remember.title: Don't remember
dont_remember.description: The participant indicated they did not remember the answer. Harmonised from BaselineMetadata.xlsx's Answers sheet, AnswerID=5 (6 uses in the source). D011 (2026-09-18) fixes -777 as the one universal recoded value, confirmed final by the steward.

not_applicable.title: Not applicable
not_applicable.description: The question did not apply to the participant. Harmonised from BaselineMetadata.xlsx's Answers sheet, AnswerID=6 (9 uses in the source). D011 (2026-09-18) fixes -666 as the one universal recoded value, confirmed final by the steward.

prefer_not_to_answer.title: Prefer not to answer
prefer_not_to_answer.description: The participant declined to answer. Harmonised from BaselineMetadata.xlsx's Answers sheet, AnswerID=7 — 0 uses in Baseline itself, reserved for future rounds (R2/R4). D011 (2026-09-18) fixes -555 as the universal recoded value, confirmed final by the steward.

not_sure.title: Not sure
not_sure.description: The participant was not sure of the answer. Harmonised from BaselineMetadata.xlsx's Answers sheet, AnswerID=8 (2 uses: Q560, Q1309). D011 (2026-09-18) fixes -444 as the universal recoded value, confirmed final by the steward.

none_of_these.title: None of these
none_of_these.description: The participant read the listed options and none applied. A real answer, not a missing value (D008, D012), so it is marked as a value. Kept here so the ETL's sentinel step can match the title (D102).
